exposure: Analysis by fetal presentation within the low-transverse cesarean section group
cohort: 128 pregnant women between 23 0/7 and 27 6/7 weeks gestation undergoing cesarean section at a single academic institution between August 2010 and December 2022.
finding: The study found that low-transverse cesarean section was significantly associated with fetal presentation, and among those with cephalic presentations, this approach was associated with a low rate of delivery complications.
mod_finding: Among those with cephalic presentations, the rate of intrapartum dystocia or hysterotomy extension was low after a low-transverse hysterotomy (6.7%).
